 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Manchester United will face Como in a UEFA Champions League league-phase match on Wednesday, October 21, at Stadio Giuseppe Sinigaglia.
 United will be hoping to bounce back from a poor run of form as Michael Carrick prepares his side for another European challenge. Meanwhile, Como will have home-field advantage and a chance to make a statement against one of England's most popular clubs.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The match will be played in the early evening in Italy, which will be available to fans in Europe, but will be in the afternoon in the Americas. Find out all the details about the kickoff time and live-streaming options around the world.
 Manchester United vs. Como Start Time
 The Champions League match will begin at 6:45 p.m. CEST on Wednesday, October 21, at Stadio Giuseppe Sinigaglia in Como. That's 5:45 p.m. BST in the United Kingdom.
